shards.prompt: Create the file demo/src/greet.rs containing exactly: a public function `pub fn greeting(name: &str) -> String` that returns `Hello, {Name}!` where {Name} is the input with its first letter uppercased. Requirement: obtain the first character with `name.chars().next().unwrap()`. Add a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with one unit test asserting `greeting("world") == "Hello, World!"`. Do NOT modify demo/src/lib.rs or any other file — the module will be wired into the crate in a later stage. Create only demo/src/greet.rs.

Create the file demo/src/farewell.rs containing exactly: a public function `pub fn farewell(name: &str) -> String` that returns the string `Goodbye, {name}.`, and a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` with one unit test asserting `farewell("World") == "Goodbye, World."`. Do NOT modify demo/src/lib.rs or any other file — the module will be wired into the crate in a later stage. Create only demo/src/farewell.rs.

stages.title: Wire modules into the crate (sequential — depends on both shards)

shards.prompt: demo/src/greet.rs and demo/src/farewell.rs already exist. Edit demo/src/lib.rs ONLY: declare `pub mod greet;` and `pub mod farewell;` and re-export both functions with `pub use greet::greeting;` and `pub use farewell::farewell;`. Do not change parse_pairs or any other code, and do not modify any other file.
